key.name: one_sided
key.script: debit_cents >= 0 and credit_cents >= 0 and (debit_cents > 0) != (credit_cents > 0)

key.name: days_since_open
key.script: (posted_on - account.opened_on).days

key.name: days_to_close
key.script: None if account.closed_on is None else (account.closed_on - posted_on).days

key.name: days_to_period_close
key.script: (policy[0].period_close - posted_on).days

key.name: currency_matches
key.script: currency == account.currency

key.name: entry_debits
key.script: sum(row.debit_cents for row in lines if row.entry_id == entry_id)

key.name: entry_credits
key.script: sum(row.credit_cents for row in lines if row.entry_id == entry_id)

key.name: balance_after
key.script: sum((row.debit_cents - row.credit_cents) * (1 if account.normal_side == 'debit' else -1) for row in lines if row.account_id == account_id and (row.posted_on, row.posting_rank, row.line_id) <= (posted_on, posting_rank, line_id))

key.name: tax_error_tenth_basis
key.script: abs(tax_cents * 10000 - {row.invoice_id: row.net_cents * row.tax_rate_bp for row in invoices}[invoice_id])

key.name: gross_is_net_plus_tax
key.script: gross_cents == {row.invoice_id: row.net_cents for row in invoices}[invoice_id] + tax_cents

key.name: payment_allocated
key.script: sum(row.amount_cents for row in allocations if row.payment_id == payment_id)

key.name: payment_amount
key.script: {row.payment_id: row.amount_cents for row in payments}[payment_id]

key.name: invoice_allocated
key.script: sum(row.amount_cents for row in allocations if row.invoice_id == invoice_id)

key.name: days_after_invoice
key.script: ({row.payment_id: row.paid_on for row in payments}[payment_id] - {row.invoice_id: row.invoice_date for row in invoice_amounts}[invoice_id]).days

key.name: same_customer
key.script: {row.payment_id: row.customer_id for row in payments}[payment_id] == {row.invoice_id: row.customer_id for row in invoice_amounts}[invoice_id]

key.name: open_before
key.script: invoice_gross - sum(row.amount_cents for row in allocations if row.invoice_id == invoice_id and row.allocation_id < allocation_id)

key.name: due_total
key.script: sum(gross_of[row.invoice_id] - sum(other.amount_cents for other in allocations if other.invoice_id == row.invoice_id and other.allocation_id < row.allocation_id) for row in allocations if row.payment_id == payment_id)

key.name: proportion_error
key.script: abs(amount_cents * due_total - payment_amount * open_before)

key.name: total_debits
key.script: sum(row.debit_cents for row in lines)

key.name: total_credits
key.script: sum(row.credit_cents for row in lines)
